name: Corc mac Luigthic
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Corc mac Luigthic is an Irish hero and king. He took the throne of Cashel in Munster. His fairy mother FEDELM attended the inauguration. During the rite his ear was burned red by magic. He sailed to Scotland to meet the king of the Picts. A foe had marked his shield with Ogham letters that called for his death. An ally changed the message to a welcome. Corc married the king daughter and set an Irish dynasty.

okr.objective: Corc mac Luigthic is a heroic king of Cashel.
key_results: He was made king at Cashel in Munster.
His ear was magically singed red at the rite.
An ally rescued him from a death plot in Scotland.
He wed the king daughter and founded a line.
